protocol: SPEC-confirmation-run-r3.md SS3.7 item 6 / SS10 item 4, extended: scout x20 and qwen x10 presentations of the same 308 development pairs, same prompt revision 3.1, temperature 0, seeded unit orders

gates.graded_support_reliability: >= 0.9 (r3's labeler bar, read on the graded instrument -- this is the number SS10 item 4 (a) turns on)

hallucinated_span_rate.denominator: presentation k = 0 only, as #501's gate was read
hallucinated_span_rate.by_anchor_note: which quoted SENTENCE failed to locate under any of the three ladders (exact / normalised / first-eight + last-eight words in one sentence). #501, with ten-word anchors, had 54 of Scout's 58 failures on the closing anchor; this split is the direct test of r3 §10 item 3

hallucinated_span_rate_all_presentations.note: sensitivity reading over all five presentations; the gate is read on k = 0

locate_ladder.note: k = 0 only. `eight_word` counts the quotes the whole-sentence match missed and the first-eight/last-eight fallback rescued — spans that would have been hallucinations under an exact-or-normalised-only rule

mean_pairwise_span_union_jaccard.note: raw Jaccard, not the >= 0.5 indicator; pairs where BOTH presentations returned nothing are excluded because their Jaccard is 0/0

self_consistency.definition: consistent iff span-union Jaccard >= 0.5 between the two presentations' evidence sets; two 'no localizable evidence' verdicts count as consistent. The gate is read on reading (i), union, over ALL pairs — #501 could only read it on 31.

whether_agreement.definition: fraction of pairs on which all five presentations agree about WHETHER the document contains localizable evidence

union_saturation.label: per judge
union_saturation.distinct_rule: D3 rule 1 — two sets merge iff span-union Jaccard >= 0.5; accumulated in presentation order, k = 0 first
union_saturation.VERDICT: SATURATING — the marginal gain at k = 20 is 0.0274, below 0.05 of the union size

enumeration_proxy_within_judge.frac_of_k0_sets_still_in_k5_union_note: 1.0 BY CONSTRUCTION, not by measurement: the union is accumulated in presentation order starting from k = 0, so every k = 0 set is a seed of it and cannot be absent. The informative direction is the one above — how much of the five-presentation union ONE presentation recovers.

no_localizable_evidence.gate: descriptive — a legal verdict, not a failure

shape_k0.deep_section_definition: every span of the pair sits in unit index >= 2, i.e. outside the abstract and the first body unit (SS6.6.6 abstract bias; Stage 0 found 3/308)

r31_reading_at_k5.note: the committed r3.1 numbers, recomputed from this file's first five presentations; they must reproduce artifacts/r31/gates-r31.json

sentence_saturation.label: scout k = 1..20

mm_fit.degenerate_note: Km reached the search ceiling (500.0): the least-squares optimum is Km -> infinity, i.e. the curve is LINEAR over the range fitted and has no identifiable asymptote. Vmax = 3810.8 and Km = 500.0 are artefacts of the grid; only the slope Vmax/Km = 7.6209 sentences per reading is identified. Do not quote this Vmax as an asymptote.

linear_fit.note: the no-saturation null; if it fits as well as Michaelis-Menten over the range measured, the data do not show saturation

sentence_saturation.unit: distinct evidence sentences, identified as (unit, sentence index); no merge rule is applied -- a sentence is either selected or not
sentence_saturation.frac_of_asymptote_note: ABSENT, not zero: the fit is degenerate (Km at the search ceiling), so there is no identifiable asymptote to take a fraction of. See mm_fit.

locator_blowups.criterion: spans_emitted >= 10 * max(spans_seen, 1) in a single reading

cross_judge.note_depth: G.cross is read at the common depth 10; the support correlation above uses each judge's FULL depth (20 / 10).

pooled.note_n2_omitted: n = 2 is not on the curve and is not reported: a 1-vs-1 split makes both halves binary indicators of a single reading each, so the 'reliability' it measures is the agreement of two readings, not the stability of a graded score. The curve starts at n = 4.

scout.criterion: spans_emitted >= 10 * max(spans_seen, 1) in a single reading

qwen.criterion: spans_emitted >= 10 * max(spans_seen, 1) in a single reading

P_ext_1.prediction: P-ext-1: Spearman-Brown reliability of graded per-sentence support at 30 pooled readings >= 0.85

sensitivity.note: the scored value is the pre-registered estimator (every pair whose union has >= 2 sentences, no exclusions). Both sensitivities are reported so the reader can see the conclusion does not rest on the estimator's choices.

P_ext_2.prediction: P-ext-2: scout's k = 20 union of distinct evidence sentences is within 10 % of the asymptote of the MM fit to its k = 1..5 curve

refit_on_all_20_points.degenerate_note: Km reached the search ceiling (500.0): the least-squares optimum is Km -> infinity, i.e. the curve is LINEAR over the range fitted and has no identifiable asymptote. Vmax = 3810.8 and Km = 500.0 are artefacts of the grid; only the slope Vmax/Km = 7.6209 sentences per reading is identified. Do not quote this Vmax as an asymptote.

THE_PASS_IS_AN_ARTEFACT_UNLESS_THIS_AGRE.why: the scored estimator is a MEAN of a heavy-tailed count. One reading in 6160 (Scout, ('2016_1', '4212306')) had a span split across units expanded by the locator into whole-unit spans covering most of the document, contributing tens of thousands of distinct sentences to one pair's union. Dropping the pairs `locator_blowups` identifies BY MECHANISM re-reads the same prediction.

blowups.criterion: spans_emitted >= 10 * max(spans_seen, 1) in a single reading

THE_PASS_IS_AN_ARTEFACT_UNLESS_THIS_AGRE.median_note: the median is unaffected by the blow-up and is reported for both readings; it is the estimator a re-run should pre-register.

P_ext_3.prediction: P-ext-3: hallucinated-span rate at the NEW presentations <= 0.05 for both judges

DECISION_SPAN_GATES: **NEITHER JUDGE PASSES THE CONJUNCTION on any reading** — the r3.1 stop stands. scout: self-consistency 0.3831 (FAIL), hallucinated 0.02517 (PASS), whether 0.8539 (FAIL); qwen: self-consistency 0.5617 (FAIL), hallucinated 0.00279 (PASS), whether 0.961 (PASS).
DECISION_GRADED_SUPPORT: Graded per-sentence support at 30 pooled readings has Spearman-Brown reliability 0.9205, against the >= 0.9 bar r3 sets for a labeler: **MEETS IT**. This is a measurement of the instrument SS10 item 4 (a) proposes, not a decision about it; the decision is the owner's and needs the human read besides.
HUMAN_HALF: PENDING-HUMAN — no human read was performed, no kappa against a human is computed, and r3 SS3.7 item 5's enumeration recall is ABSENT, not zero. The R-dev pairs were not read.
